title: bauhinia cheilantha
intro: Bauhinia cheilantha, commonly known as the yellow bauhinia, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fever, as well as treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Bauhinia cheilantha are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce coughing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
